source: official TCL Smart TV FOTA API (huan.tv) & CDN (cedock.com)

api_fields_documentation.platform: Primary hardware platform identifier code (e.g., '0012T01', '0008T01', 'T653T01') matching the TV SoC.
api_fields_documentation.alt_platform_id: Secondary or legacy alphanumeric platform identifier used interchangeably in OTA requests.
api_fields_documentation.family_name: Human-readable hardware family and chassis title.
api_fields_documentation.soc_specs: Technical hardware specifications of the System-on-Chip (SoC) processor and graphics engine.
api_fields_documentation.featured_models: Known and verified TV model series associated with this platform (selection of examples).
api_fields_documentation.latest_firmware: Latest verified Production (Stable) firmware release version code (e.g., 'V8-0012T01-LF1V655').
api_fields_documentation.release_type: Installation package type: 'Full OTA (ZIP)', 'Incremental OTA', or 'IMG / PKG Recovery'.
api_fields_documentation.is_test_release: Boolean flag indicating if the primary package is a Beta/Test release candidate (R/M build).
api_fields_documentation.package_size: Formatted binary package file size in GB/MB.
api_fields_documentation.release_date: Official publication date or build compilation date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM).
api_fields_documentation.md5: Cryptographic MD5 hash checksum from FOTA server for payload verification.
api_fields_documentation.sha256: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash checksum for enhanced security and binary verification.
api_fields_documentation.crc32: IEEE 802.3 32-bit Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC32) hexadecimal checksum.
api_fields_documentation.changelog: Official release notes and changelog description extracted from server XML response (<description>/<note>).

extracted_details.os_flavor: Operating system experience flavor ('Google TV (GTV)' vs 'Android TV (ATV)').
extracted_details.gms_version: Google Mobile Services / Experience package designation (e.g., 'Android_14_GTV_U').
extracted_details.build_date_utc: Unix epoch compilation timestamp of the build (e.g., 1786113311).
extracted_details.sdk_level: Android API SDK level integer (e.g., 34 for Android 14, 31 for Android 12).

api_fields_documentation.stable: Detailed attributes of the latest verified Production (Stable) firmware release.
api_fields_documentation.beta: Detailed attributes of the latest active Beta / Release Candidate (RC) firmware release (null if none available).
api_fields_documentation.test: Detailed attributes of the latest active Manufacturing / Pre-production Test firmware release (null if none available).
api_fields_documentation.download_url: Direct primary CDN download link for the package.
api_fields_documentation.recovery_pkg_url: Direct CDN download link for factory recovery flash image (.pkg / .img / _PKG.zip), if available.
api_fields_documentation.recovery_pkg_size: Formatted binary file size of the recovery package in GB/MB.
api_fields_documentation.recovery_pkg_md5: Cryptographic MD5 hash checksum for the recovery package.
api_fields_documentation.recovery_pkg_sha256: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash checksum for the recovery package.
api_fields_documentation.all_cdn_urls: Object containing regional CDN mirror URLs mapped by region key ('eu', 'na', 'as').
api_fields_documentation.fota_api_status: Validation and connection status against the official live TCL FOTA upgrade server.
api_fields_documentation.checked_at: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp recording when the platform was last queried against the server.
